pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED READING: READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading 2.1 Guided Reading : Reading Fluency (2 Sessions) • Speed • Expression •
Topic 2.3: Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you show love to your family members?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary related to the family in a text
2. appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED READING: READING COMPREHENSION
This lesson teaches Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension for Grade 8 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify vocabulary related to the family in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension above.
2. Explain Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you show love to your family members?
2. How can you tell the meaning of a new word in a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vocabulary related to the family in a text
2. appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
